## F03.import-syntax — Import syntax

Definition: How one instruction file pulls in another.

## F03.precedence-scoping — Precedence and scoping

Definition: Which file wins and how directories nest.
- claude-code [supported, unverified] CLAUDE.md files are additive: all levels contribute to context at once. Files from the working directory and above load at launch; subdirectories load as you work in them. Locations load in order from broadest to most specific scope, so a project instruction appears after a user instruction. When instructions conflict, Claude uses judgment to reconcile them. | ev: E-claude-code-09271, E-claude-code-11202
- codex-cli [supported, verified] Codex can load a global file from your Codex home directory plus repo-specific files; files closer to the working directory take precedence. It discovers AGENTS.md by walking up from the working directory to a project root. Code review applies the root and more-specific guidance that covers each changed file. | ev: E-codex-cli-03153, E-codex-cli-02975, E-codex-cli-04996
- copilot-cli [partial, verified] All custom instruction files combine instead of using priority-based fallbacks.
